description: Item 1 of PR #1708: tests the SUMMED non-abelian Stokes form over the 𝓑_3 octahedron tessellation for the α_em 2/(3π) shift. Prior probes used individual torus knots / cells (refuted); this tests the explicit cell SUM. Honest derive-or-refute.

data.verdict: REFUTED for genuine summed-volume forms. Only TAUTOLOGICAL rewrites (2/(N_cusps·π) with N_cusps=3; Σ_3·(2/9π); and 2·V_oct/(Vol_Bor·π)·(2/3) where V_oct/Vol_Bor=1/2 cancels exactly) reproduce 2/(3π) — all three ASSUME the answer. Genuine hyperbolic-volume sums miss: best is (f) V_oct / (2π²) at -12.5317%. The multi-cell SUMMED Yekutieli route does NOT structurally derive the 2/(3π) shift coefficient — consistent with the individual-cell refutations (torus-knot 1e6 ppm, H_3 matter −445%, q-Lambert NULL). The N_cusps=3 reading of the '3' is a plausible INTERPRETATION but the coefficient '2' and the 1/π factor are not derived; the shift's structural origin remains open (RT-2-loop track).
data.N_cusps_reading: 3 (Borromean is 3-component link); consistent but not derived
